```{r}
asdf <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.unfiltered.rds")
`%!in%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

tcr_genes <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJC]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
ig_genes <- grep("^IG[JHKL][VDJCMG]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
hemoglobin <- grep("^HB[AB]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)

ss <- subset(asdf, orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 1:152))
ss <- subset(ss, db.class == "singlet" & nCount_RNA > 600 & nCount_RNA < 50000 & nFeature_RNA >300)

ss <- FindVariableFeatures(ss, nfeatures = 2000)
vf <- VariableFeatures(ss)
vf <- setdiff(vf, c(tcr_genes, ig_genes, g2m.genes, s.genes, hemoglobin))

split.ss <- SplitObject(ss, split.by = "orig.ident")

split.ss <- split.ss[names(split.ss) != "S83"]
split.ss2 <- lapply(split.ss, function(x) {
  x <- SCTransform(x, variable.features.n = 5, vars.to.regress = "percent.rb")
  return(x)
})
saveRDS(split.ss2, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/split.ss2.rds")

split.ss2 <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/split.ss2.rds")
merge <- merge(x = split.ss2[[1]], y = split.ss2[-1])
saveRDS(merge, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/merge2.rds")
merge <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(merge)

DefaultAssay(merge) <- "SCT"
merge@assays$RNA <- NULL

s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes

merge <- CellCycleScoring(merge, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = F)
merge$cc.total <- merge$S.Score+merge$G2M.Score

saveRDS(merge, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/merge2.rds")

#merge <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/merge2.rds")

VariableFeatures(merge) <- vf

merge <- ScaleData(merge)
merge <- RunPCA(merge)
merge <- RunHarmony(merge, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "SCT", reduction.save = "harmony", ncores = 30)
merge <- RunUMAP(merge, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony")

DimPlot(merge, group.by = "orig.ident", shuffle = T, raster = F)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(merge, group.by = "cloneType", shuffle = T, raster = F)+NoLegend()

FeaturePlot(merge, "S.Score")
FeaturePlot(merge, "G2M.Score")
FeaturePlot(merge, "cc.total")
FeaturePlot(merge, "percent.mt")
FeaturePlot(merge, "percent.rb")
FeaturePlot(merge, "nCount_RNA")
FeaturePlot(merge, "nFeature_RNA")

saveRDS(merge, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/merge2.rds")
```

```{r}
Idents(merge) <- merge$umap.snn_res.0.05

markers <- FindAllMarkers(merge, min.pct = .1, only.pos = T, max.cells.per.ident = 10000)
markers$dif <- markers$pct.1 - markers$pct.2

markers.ss <- markers %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  arrange(desc(dif)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10)

merge <- RenameIdents(merge, "0" = "T_Cells",
                     "1" = "T_Cells",
                     "2" = "T_Cells",
                     "3" = "T_Cells",
                     "4" = "T_Cells",
                     "5" = "Myeloid",
                     "6" = "Fibroblasts",
                     "7" = "T_Cells",
                     "8" = "T_Cells",
                     "9" = "T_Cells",
                     "10" = "Keratinocytes",
                     "11" = "T_Cells",
                     "12" = "T_Cells",
                     "13" = "Vasc_Endo",
                     "14" = "B_Cells",

merge$celltype <- Idents(merge)

DimPlot(merge, group.by = "celltype", label = T)+NoLegend()
```

```{r}
merge$Dx <- ifelse(merge$Dx == "Mycosis fungoides", "MF",
                                  ifelse(merge$Dx == "Sezary Syndrome", "SS",
                                  ifelse(merge$Dx == "Healthy Control", "HC",
                                  ifelse(merge$Dx == "Primary Cutaneous Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma", "PCALCL",
                                  ifelse(merge$Dx == "Follicular Mycosis Fungoides", "FMF", "missing")))))

merge$has.tcr <- ifelse(is.na(merge$cloneType), "No_TCR", "TCR")

merge$Path.Stage.numeric <- ifelse(merge$Path.Stage %in% c("IA", "IB", "I"), "Stage_I",
                                  ifelse(merge$Path.Stage %in% c("IIA", "IIB", "II"), "Stage_II",
                                  ifelse(merge$Path.Stage %in% c("IIIA", "IIIB", "III"), "Stage_III",
                                  ifelse(merge$Path.Stage %in% c("IVA", "IVB", "IV"), "Stage_IV", "HC"))))
merge$Path.Stage.bin <- ifelse(merge$Path.Stage %in% c("IA", "IB", "IIA"), "Early_Stage",
                                  ifelse(merge$Path.Stage %in% c("IIB", "IIIA", "IIIB", "IVA", "IVB", "IV"), "Late_Stage", "HC"))
merge$Sample.Type.simple <- ifelse(merge$Sample.Type %in% c("patch", "plaque", "patch/plaque"), "patch/plaque",
                                  ifelse(merge$Sample.Type %in% c("tumor", "nodule"), "tumor",
                                  ifelse(merge$Sample.Type %in% c("blood"), "blood",
                                  ifelse(merge$Sample.Type %in% c("erythroderma"), "erythroderma",
                                  ifelse(merge$Sample.Type %in% c("HC", "nonlesional", "resolved lesion"), "HC/non_lesional",
                                  ifelse(merge$Sample.Type %in% c("lymph node"), "lymph_node",
                                  ifelse(merge$Sample.Type %in% c("erythroderma"), "erythroderma",
                                  ifelse(merge$Sample.Type %in% c("lesional"), "lesional_NOS","HC"))))))))

merge$celltype <- factor(merge$celltype, levels = sort(levels(merge$celltype)))

merge$hyper <- ifelse(merge$cloneType == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)", "hyper", "non")
merge$hyper[is.na(merge$cloneType)] <- "NA"
table(merge$hyper)

saveRDS(merge, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/merge3.rds")
```

```{r}
#merge <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/merge.final.rds")
table(merge$celltype)
t.cells <- subset(merge, celltype == "T_Cells")
df.t.sample.hyper <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$hyper))
df.t.sample.hyper.ss <- subset(df.t.sample.hyper, hyper > 3)

#check <- subset(t.cells, CTgene %in% c("NA.NA.NA_NA.NA.NA.NA","NA_NA.NA.NA.NA","NA.NA.NA_NA"))
#df.missing.ctaa <- as.data.frame(table(check$CTaa))
#t.cells$CTgene[t.cells$orig.ident %in% unique(check$orig.ident)] <- t.cells$CTaa[t.cells$orig.ident %in% unique(check$orig.ident)]

# Split CTgene into alpha and beta chains
t.cells$split.alpha <- stringr::str_split(t.cells$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
t.cells$split.beta <- stringr::str_split(t.cells$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 2]

table(t.cells$hyper)

list <- rownames(df.t.sample.hyper.ss)
# Initialize storage for new clone assignments
ss <- subset(t.cells, hyper == "hyper" & orig.ident %in% list)
  
split.alpha <- ss$split.alpha
names(split.alpha) <- ss$barcode
split.alpha <- split.alpha[split.alpha != "" & !is.na(split.alpha) & split.alpha != "NA"]
  
split.beta <- ss$split.beta
names(split.beta) <- ss$barcode
split.beta <- split.beta[split.beta != "" & !is.na(split.beta) & split.beta != "NA"]

table(ss$orig.ident)

#save.new.clones <- character()

t.cells$shared.alpha <- NA
t.cells$shared.beta <- NA

for (i in seq_along(list)) {
  # Subset the cells by orig.ident
  idx <- t.cells$orig.ident == list[i]
  
  sample <- list[i]
  
  current_alpha <- t.cells$split.alpha[idx]
  current_beta <- t.cells$split.beta[idx]
  
  alpha.top <- as.data.frame(table(t.cells$split.alpha[idx]))
  beta.top <- as.data.frame(table(t.cells$split.beta[idx]))

  alpha.top <- subset(alpha.top, Var1 != "NA" & Var1 != "")
  beta.top <- subset(beta.top, Var1 != "NA" & Var1 != "")
  
  alpha.top$pct <- alpha.top$Freq/sum(alpha.top$Freq)*100
  beta.top$pct <- beta.top$Freq/sum(beta.top$Freq)*100

  alpha.top.aa <- as.character(alpha.top$Var1[which.max(alpha.top$Freq)])
  beta.top.aa <- as.character(beta.top$Var1[which.max(beta.top$Freq)])
  
  t.cells$shared.alpha[idx] <- current_alpha %in% alpha.top.aa
  t.cells$shared.beta[idx] <- current_beta %in% beta.top.aa
}

t.cells$shared.clone <- ifelse(t.cells$shared.alpha | t.cells$shared.beta, "Shared", "Unique")

table(t.cells$cloneType, t.cells$shared.clone)

```



```{r}
additional.clones <- readRDS(file = "extra.malig.rds")
non.malig <- readRDS(file = "extra.non.malig.rds")

table(t.cells$hyper)

t.cells$xgboost <- ifelse(t.cells$hyper == "hyper" & t.cells$shared.clone == "Shared", "malig",
                          ifelse(t.cells$hyper == "non" & t.cells$shared.clone == "Unique", "non_malig", "query"))
table(t.cells$xgboost)
t.cells$xgboost[is.na(t.cells$xgboost)] <- "query"
table(t.cells$xgboost)
t.cells$xgboost[t.cells$barcode %in% additional.clones] <- "malig"
t.cells$xgboost[t.cells$barcode %in% non.malig] <- "non_malig"
table(t.cells$xgboost)

merge$xgboost <- t.cells$xgboost

objects_to_keep <- c("merge", "t.cells", "markers", "markers.ss", "%!in%")
# Remove all objects except the ones to keep
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), objects_to_keep))
gc()
```



```{r}
#Run xgboost
all.predictions <- readRDS("sct.xgboost.all.predictions.rds")

table(t.cells$xgboost)
all.predictions <- ifelse(all.predictions > 0.5, "malig", "non_malig")
table(all.predictions)

query.malig <- names(all.predictions[all.predictions == "malig"])
query.non_malig <- names(all.predictions[all.predictions == "non_malig"])


t.cells$final.clones <- t.cells$xgboost
table(t.cells$final.clones)
t.cells$final.clones[t.cells$barcode %in% query.malig] <- "malig"
t.cells$final.clones[t.cells$barcode %in% query.non_malig] <- "non_malig"
table(t.cells$final.clones)
table(t.cells$final.clones, t.cells$xgboost)

df.samples <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$final.clones))
table(t.cells$Dx)
t.cells$final.clones[t.cells$Dx == "Healthy Control"] <- "non_malig"
df.samples <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$final.clones))


final.query.malig <- readRDS("final.query.malig.rds")

table(t.cells$final.clones)
t.cells$final.clones[t.cells$barcode %in% final.query.malig] <- "malig"
t.cells$final.clones[t.cells$final.clones =="query"] <- "non_malig"
table(t.cells$final.clones)

merge$final.clones <- t.cells$final.clones
saveRDS(merge, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/merge3.rds")

rm(final.query.malig, query.malig, query.non_malig, all.predictions, df.samples)
gc()
```
